description: Retrieve real-time ADS-B state vectors for all aircraft currently within a geographic bounding box. Returns ICAO24 transponder address, callsign, origin country, position (lat/lon), barometric altitude, velocity, heading, vertical rate, squawk code, and position source (ADS-B/MLAT/FLARM). Data is updated every ~10 seconds from the OpenSky community network of ~5,000 ADS-B receivers. Specify lamin/lomin/lamax/lomax in decimal degrees. Limit per call: 1,000 aircraft (use smaller bbox for dense airspace). Source: OpenSky Network — opensky-network.org. No auth, open access.

lamax.description: Maximum latitude of the bounding box in decimal degrees (e.g. 55.0)

lamin.description: Minimum latitude of the bounding box in decimal degrees (e.g. 47.0)

limit.description: Maximum number of aircraft to return (default 100, max 1000)

lomax.description: Maximum longitude of the bounding box in decimal degrees (e.g. 15.0)

lomin.description: Minimum longitude of the bounding box in decimal degrees (e.g. 5.0)

name: opensky.traffic.states_bbox

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: OpenSky — Live Aircraft in Bounding Box
